pilgrim_hello.speaker: OLD PILGRIM
lines: So the village burned after all. And you alone walked out of the fire.
Rest by the flame when you are hurt. The dead rise again when you rest... but so do you.
The cave to the east swallows every light. There is a torch in that old chest - take it.
Go on, then. I am only an old man resting his feet.
